claim_en: 1,000 genomes project enables mapping of genetic sequence variation consisting of rare variants with larger penetrance effects than common variants.
claim_zh: 千人基因组计划使得绘制由罕见变异构成的遗传序列变异图谱成为可能，这些罕见变异的外显效应比常见变异更大。

claim_en: 1/2000 in UK have abnormal PrP positivity.
claim_zh: 英国约每 2000 人中就有 1 人异常朊蛋白（PrP）检测呈阳性。

claim_en: ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA.
claim_zh: ADAR1 与 Dicer 结合，从而切割前体 miRNA。

claim_en: AIRE is expressed in some skin tumors.
claim_zh: AIRE 在部分皮肤肿瘤中有表达。

claim_en: ALDH1 expression is associated with poorer prognosis in breast cancer.
claim_zh: ALDH1 表达与乳腺癌患者较差的预后相关。

claim_en: APOE4 expression in iPSC-derived neurons increases AlphaBeta production and tau phosphorylation causing GABA neuron degeneration.
claim_zh: 在诱导多能干细胞分化的神经元中表达 APOE4 会增加 β 淀粉样蛋白的生成和 tau 蛋白磷酸化，导致 GABA 能神经元退化。

claim_en: Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.
claim_zh: PPM1D 的激活会抑制 p53 的功能。

claim_en: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
claim_zh: 所有造血干细胞在分裂时都随机分离其染色体。

claim_en: Angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors are associated with increased risk for functional renal insufficiency.
claim_zh: 血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂与功能性肾功能不全风险升高相关。

claim_en: Antibiotic induced alterations in the gut microbiome reduce resistance against Clostridium difficile
claim_zh: 抗生素引起的肠道菌群改变会降低机体对艰难梭菌的抵抗力。

claim_en: Antiretroviral therapy reduces rates of tuberculosis across a broad range of CD4 strata.
claim_zh: 在 CD4 计数的各个分层中，抗逆转录病毒治疗都能降低结核病的发生率。

claim_en: Articles published in open access format are more likely to be cited than traditional journals.
claim_zh: 以开放获取形式发表的论文比传统期刊论文更容易被引用。

claim_en: Asymptomatic visual impairment screening in elderly populations does not lead to improved vision.
claim_zh: 在老年人群中开展无症状视力损害筛查并不能改善视力。

claim_en: Auditory entrainment is strengthened when people see congruent visual and auditory information.
claim_zh: 当人们同时看到一致的视觉和听觉信息时，听觉节律同步会增强。

claim_en: Autophagy declines in aged organisms.
claim_zh: 衰老个体的细胞自噬水平会下降。

claim_en: Bariatric surgery has a positive impact on mental health.
claim_zh: 减重手术对心理健康有积极影响。

claim_en: Birth-weight is positively associated with breast cancer.
claim_zh: 出生体重与乳腺癌风险呈正相关。

claim_en: CHEK2 is not associated with breast cancer.
claim_zh: CHEK2 与乳腺癌无关。

claim_en: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells promotes airway inflammation.
claim_zh: Th2 细胞上的 CX3CR1 会促进气道炎症。

claim_en: Carriers of the alcohol aldehyde dehydrogenase deficiency mutation drink less that non-carries.
claim_zh: 携带乙醛脱氢酶缺陷突变的人饮酒量少于非携带者。

claim_en: Cellular aging closely links to an older appearance.
claim_zh: 细胞衰老与外貌显老密切相关。

claim_en: Chenodeosycholic acid treatment increases whole-body energy expenditure.
claim_zh: 鹅去氧胆酸治疗会增加全身能量消耗。

claim_en: Chronic aerobic exercise alters endothelial function, improving vasodilating mechanisms mediated by NO.
claim_zh: 长期有氧运动会改变血管内皮功能，增强一氧化氮介导的血管舒张机制。

claim_en: Combining phosphatidylinositide 3-kinase and MEK 1/2 inhibitors is effective at treating KRAS mutant tumors.
claim_zh: 联合使用磷脂酰肌醇 3-激酶抑制剂和 MEK 1/2 抑制剂可以有效治疗 KRAS 突变肿瘤。

claim_en: Crosstalk between dendritic cells (DCs) and innate lymphoid cells (ILCs) is important in the regulation of intestinal homeostasis.
claim_zh: 树突状细胞与固有淋巴细胞之间的相互作用对维持肠道稳态很重要。

claim_en: Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space to cytosol during apoptosis.
claim_zh: 细胞凋亡过程中，细胞色素 c 会从线粒体膜间隙释放到细胞质中。

claim_en: Diabetic patients with acute coronary syndrome experience increased short-term and long-term risk for bleeding events.
claim_zh: 患有急性冠脉综合征的糖尿病患者，短期和长期出血事件风险都会升高。

claim_en: Enhanced early production of inflammatory chemokines improves viral control in the lung.
claim_zh: 早期炎性趋化因子分泌增强可以改善肺部对病毒的控制。

claim_en: Errors in peripheral IV drug administration are most common during bolus administration and multiple-step medicine preparations.
claim_zh: 外周静脉给药的差错最常发生在推注给药和多步骤配药环节。

claim_en: Exposure to fine particulate air pollution is relate to anxiety prevalence.
claim_zh: 暴露于细颗粒物空气污染与焦虑症患病率相关。

claim_en: Female carriers of the Apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) allele have increased risk for dementia.
claim_zh: 携带载脂蛋白 E4（APOE4）等位基因的女性患痴呆的风险更高。

claim_en: Free histones are degraded by a Rad53-dependent mechanism once DNA has been replicated.
claim_zh: DNA 复制完成后，游离组蛋白会通过依赖 Rad53 的机制被降解。

claim_en: GATA-3 is important for hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) function.
claim_zh: GATA-3 对造血干细胞的功能很重要。

claim_en: Glycolysis is one of the primary glycometabolic pathways in cells.
claim_zh: 糖酵解是细胞内主要的糖代谢途径之一。

claim_en: Headaches are not correlated with cognitive impairment.
claim_zh: 头痛与认知功能障碍之间没有相关性。

claim_en: Hyperfibrinogenemia increases rates of femoropopliteal bypass thrombosis.
claim_zh: 高纤维蛋白原血症会提高股腘动脉旁路移植术后血栓形成的发生率。

claim_en: Hypoglycemia increases the risk of dementia.
claim_zh: 低血糖会增加患痴呆的风险。

claim_en: Hypothalamic glutamate neurotransmission is crucial to energy balance.
claim_zh: 下丘脑的谷氨酸神经传递对维持能量平衡至关重要。

claim_en: IRG1 has antiviral effects against neurotropic viruses.
claim_zh: IRG1 对嗜神经病毒具有抗病毒作用。

claim_en: In adult tissue, most T cells are memory T cells.
claim_zh: 在成人组织中，大多数 T 细胞是记忆 T 细胞。

claim_en: In young and middle-aged adults, current or remote uses of ADHD medications do not increase the risk of serious cardiovascular events.
claim_zh: 在中青年人群中，正在或曾经使用 ADHD 药物并不会增加严重心血管事件的风险。

claim_en: Incidence of heart failure decreased by 10% in women since 1979.
claim_zh: 自 1979 年以来，女性心力衰竭的发病率下降了 10%。

claim_en: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.
claim_zh: 宫颈癌的发病率已经下降。

claim_en: Insomnia can be effectively treated with cognitive behavioral therapy.
claim_zh: 认知行为疗法可以有效治疗失眠。

claim_en: Leuko-reduced blood reduces infectious complications in red blood cell transfusion.
claim_zh: 去白细胞血液可以减少红细胞输血中的感染并发症。

claim_en: Ly49Q directs the organization of neutrophil migration to inflammation sites by regulating membrane raft functions.
claim_zh: Ly49Q 通过调节膜筏功能，引导中性粒细胞向炎症部位迁移。

claim_en: Macrolides have no protective effect against myocardial infarction.
claim_zh: 大环内酯类抗生素对心肌梗死没有保护作用。

claim_en: Macropinocytosis contributes to a cell's supply of amino acids via the intracellular uptake of protein.
claim_zh: 巨胞饮作用通过把蛋白质摄入细胞内，为细胞提供氨基酸。

claim_en: Many proteins in human cells can be post-translationally modified at lysine residues via acetylation.
claim_zh: 人体细胞中的许多蛋白质可以在赖氨酸残基上发生乙酰化翻译后修饰。

claim_en: MicroRNA is involved in the regulation of Neural Stem Cell (NSC) differentiation and proliferation dynamic homeostasis
claim_zh: 微小 RNA 参与调控神经干细胞分化与增殖的动态平衡。

claim_en: Monoclonal antibody targeting of N-cadherin inhibits metastasis.
claim_zh: 靶向 N-钙黏蛋白的单克隆抗体可以抑制肿瘤转移。

claim_en: Most termination events in Okazaki fragments are sequence specific.
claim_zh: 冈崎片段中的大多数终止事件具有序列特异性。

claim_en: N348I mutations cause resistance to zidovudine (AZT).
claim_zh: N348I 突变会导致对齐多夫定（AZT）的耐药。

claim_en: Deamination of cytidine to uridine on the minus strand of viral DNA results in catastrophic G-to-A mutations in the viral genome.
claim_zh: 病毒 DNA 负链上胞苷脱氨变为尿苷，会导致病毒基因组中出现灾难性的 G 到 A 突变。

claim_en: Epigenetic modulating agents (EMAs) modulate antitumor immune response in a cancer model system.
claim_zh: 在癌症模型中，表观遗传调节剂可以调节抗肿瘤免疫反应。

claim_en: FoxO3a activation in neuronal death is mediated by reactive oxygen species (ROS).
claim_zh: 神经元死亡过程中 FoxO3a 的激活是由活性氧介导的。

claim_en: Lupus-prone mice infected with curliproducing bacteria have higher autoantibody titers compared to controls.
claim_zh: 感染产卷曲菌毛细菌的狼疮易感小鼠，其自身抗体滴度高于对照组。

claim_en: Increased microtubule acetylation repairs LRRK2 Roc-COR domain mutation induced locomotor deficits.
claim_zh: 提高微管乙酰化水平可以修复 LRRK2 Roc-COR 结构域突变引起的运动缺陷。

claim_en: Hypocretin neurones induce panicprone state in rats.
claim_zh: 下丘脑分泌素神经元会诱导大鼠进入易惊恐状态。

claim_en: Assembly of invadopodia is triggered by focal generation of phosphatidylinositol-3,4-biphosphate and the activation of the nonreceptor tyrosine kinase Src.
claim_zh: 侵袭伪足的组装由局部生成的磷脂酰肌醇-3,4-二磷酸和非受体酪氨酸激酶 Src 的激活所触发。
